datasets.name: ALOS-2 SAR image of northern Kyushu area, Japan
datasets.verbatim: The data used for the experiments are an SAR image (Fig. 4) taken by Advanced Land Observing Satellite No. 2 (ALOS-2), which shows the northern Kyushu area in Japan on July 7, 2017.

datasets.name: Landslide area annotations
datasets.verbatim: The dots in Fig. 4 show the location of landslide areas that were annotated by the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan.[30] ... [30] Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI), Ministry of Land, Infrastructure,Transport and Tourism, http://www.gsi.go.jp/english/index.html

methods.name: Segmentation network with multiattention
methods.summary: An encoder-decoder network based on ResNet that incorporates global attention modules (combining position and channel attention) and attention refinement modules to extract and refine features for landslide segmentation in SAR images.
methods.source: Yong An, Jianwu Long, Shingo Mabu
methods.verbatim: We propose a new segmentation method with multiattention modules redesigning an encoder–decoder network, that consists of ResNet [2] and some attention modules.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced and linked, and the ALOS-2 SAR imagery is practically accessible via JAXA, but the custom segmentation network code is not available.
